summary: The entire State of New York Congressional delegation collectively expressed support for the Buffalo Metrorail project in February 1976, pressing for its approval. This action is described as part of a broader community and political support effort documented in the EIS. No specific complaints or objections are attributed to the delegation.
complaint_summary: In February 1976, the entire State of New York Congressional delegation united to press for approval of the Buffalo Metrorail project, indicating strong political support for the transit initiative.
